'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Chris Schoenthal DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Nosla Eoj
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
